payload.reasoning_hinge_summary: The candidate must recognize that the equality of heat transfer (Q_lost = Q_gained) implies an inverse proportionality between the temperature change and the product of mass and specific heat capacity (mc).
payload.expected_mid_student_error: Students will likely fail to multiply the mass and specific heat ratios together, instead applying only one of the two factors to the temperature change.
notes: The design successfully avoids plug-and-chug by using algebraic multiples, forcing the student to understand the relationship rather than just calculating a value.
The difficulty level is appropriate for an 'Easy' ESAT question as it tests a fundamental concept without requiring complex multi-step derivations.
